alternative_norm_sandwich.statement: On the SAME graph core and with the same graph forcing, ||w||H^(-a) <= C||w||Y <= Cprime||w||H^b for finite a,b. A bounded Y Duhamel estimate would then imply a fixed finite-loss Sobolev estimate.
alternative_norm_sandwich.examples: An elliptic finite-order invertible transformation with a parametrix qualifies when these estimates hold. A non-elliptic projection or infinite-order weight need not qualify.
